description: This Java class 'CommonEvents' provides various utility methods for web application event handling, including setting user session preferences (locale, timezone, theme, currency), generating CAPTCHA images, handling JWT tokens, and opening source files for debugging. It is part of the 'org.apache.ofbiz.common' package and contains methods that interact with HTTP requests/responses, session attributes, and external resources.

classes.name: CommonEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing web event handling methods for user preferences, CAPTCHA, JWT, and source file access within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setSessionLocale
methods.description: Sets the user's session locale based on request parameter and updates the user login cache.

methods.name: setSessionTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the user's session time zone based on request parameter and updates the user login cache.

methods.name: setSessionTheme
methods.description: Sets the user's session visual theme based on request parameter.

methods.name: setSessionCurrencyUom
methods.description: Sets the user's session currency unit of measure and updates the user login cache.

methods.name: jsResponseFromRequest
methods.description: Returns JavaScript content from a cached script based on request parameter.

methods.name: jsonResponseFromRequestAttributes
methods.description: Generates JSON response from request attributes, filtering out ignored attributes.

methods.name: writeJSONtoResponse
methods.description: Writes a JSON object to the HTTP response with proper headers and encoding.

methods.name: getCaptcha
methods.description: Generates a CAPTCHA image, stores the code in session, and writes the image to response.

methods.name: loadJWT
methods.description: Creates a JWT token for the secured user login ID and writes it as JSON response.

methods.name: openSourceFile
methods.description: Opens a source file in an external editor for debugging, based on request parameters.
